luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0043.trim_scope: i5 eDrive35L / eDrive40L / xDrive50L (2026); 5 Series Li shares the cabin
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0043.value: 12.3" instrument display + 14.9" central display; no passenger display listed
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0043.notes: CarNewsChina spec database (2026 i5, 3,105 mm wheelbase). Xinhua (Apr 2025) refers to the system in Chinese 5 Series LWB / i5 as the 'ninth-generation BMW operating system' (第九代操作系统), China naming. Rivals in CN commonly add a passenger screen; none listed here.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0044.value: HUD optional on i5 eDrive35L, standard on i5 eDrive40L and xDrive50L
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0044.notes: For the 2026 ICE 5 Series Li, the Feb 2026 launch article (https://chejiahao.autohome.com.cn/info/24819297) says mid/high trims additionally get a full-colour HUD; entry 525Li not listed with HUD.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0047.notes: No fetched CN source states smartphone projection for G68. The Feb 2026 launch article says 5G network is now standard on entry trims.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0049.value: Phone digital key not listed; 'Smart Remote Key' listed
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0049.notes: DE list has BMW Digital Key standard (E0007); CN status not verified.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0050.value: Driver assistance level 'L2'; highway NOA / navigate-on-autopilot and hands-free not listed
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0050.notes: No fetched source documents a hands-free or NOA function for G68. Gap vs Chinese rivals (Huawei ADS, Xiaomi, NIO, Zeekr), which market highway and urban NOA.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0053.value: Massage not listed in fetched CN sources
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0053.notes: Launch article says top trims 'strengthen rear comfort' but names no items.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0055.value: Air suspension listed as 'yes' on all three i5 variants
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0055.notes: Type (rear-axle only, as on the US i5) not specified by the database. Status for ICE 525Li/530Li not verified.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0056.value: Integral Active Steering and variable steering ratio listed as 'no' on all three i5 variants
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0056.notes: Status for ICE 5 Series Li not verified. In DE rear-axle steering is optional/standard depending on model (E0014).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0057.notes: i5 eDrive35L 602 km CLTC (81.6 kWh), xDrive50L 651 km CLTC (97 kWh). CN i5 gets a larger 97 kWh pack than the EU/US 81.2 kWh. CLTC is not comparable to WLTP/EPA. Launch MSRPs 368,000 / 408,000 / 458,000 CNY.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0061.trim_scope: i5 eDrive35L / eDrive40L (Harman Kardon); xDrive50L (Bowers & Wilkins)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0061.value: Harman Kardon on eDrive35L and eDrive40L; Bowers & Wilkins (17 speakers) on xDrive50L
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0061.notes: Database speaker counts as summarised: Harman Kardon 6 (eDrive35L) / 12 (eDrive40L); the 6-speaker figure looks implausible for Harman Kardon and should be verified. Search snippets say the top ICE 530Li trim has B&W, not verified by fetch.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0062.value: Non-opening panoramic glass roof listed on all three i5 variants
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0062.notes: Contrast: DE optional (EUR 1,630), US standard tilt-and-slide moonroof with Sky Lounge optional. ICE 5 Series Li roof by trim not verified.
